# ThreadSanitizer suppressions — third-party races only.
#
# A line here is a CLAIM, so each one names whose code it is and why the race
# is not ours to fix. Our own code never belongs in this file: a race in core,
# backend or a test is either a missing fiber annotation or a real bug, and a
# suppression would hide it. The fiber switch tells TSan itself
# (__tsan_switch_to_fiber in ibFiber::SwitchTo); that path is not suppressed.
#
# Format: https://github.com/google/sanitizers/wiki/ThreadSanitizerSuppressions
#   race:<substring of the stack>
#   deadlock:<substring>
#   called_from_lib:<library>
